pro_course_detail.title: "Business English for Professionals: Improve Communication Skills"
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking to enhance your English for professional settings? I offer Business English lessons tailored to your specific needs. Whether you're preparing for interviews, making presentations, or improving your writing and communication skills at work, my lessons will help you gain confidence and fluency in a business environment.

We’ll focus on key areas such as:

Business writing (emails, reports, proposals)
Presentation skills
Negotiation and meeting strategies
Vocabulary for professional settings
Telephone and video call etiquette
Lessons are designed for professionals looking to take their English to the next level, regardless of industry. Let’s work together to achieve your goals and help you succeed in your career

pro_course_detail.title: English Exam Preparation: Achieve Your Best Score!
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you preparing for an English exam and need focused support? I specialize in helping students prepare for exams . In our lessons, we’ll cover essential exam strategies, key skills, and practice questions to help you perform confidently and effectively.

What we’ll focus on:

Listening, reading, writing, and speaking skills
Exam-specific strategies (time management, answering techniques)
Practice tests and feedback
Building vocabulary for exam success
Improving fluency and confidence under exam conditions
Whether you're preparing for an academic exam, professional certification, or university entry, I’ll help guide you to achieve your target score. Let's work together to get you exam-ready!

pro_course_detail.title: English for Travel: Speak Confidently on Your Adventures
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you planning to travel and want to feel confident speaking English? Whether you're visiting an English-speaking country or navigating an international destination, I can help you prepare for everyday situations that require English.

In my lessons, we’ll focus on:

Essential travel vocabulary (transportation, accommodation, food, etc.)
Making hotel reservations and checking in/out
Ordering food at restaurants and cafes
Asking for directions and getting around in a new city
Airport and train station interactions
Handling emergencies (lost luggage, medical help, etc.)
Cultural tips and etiquette
With these practical language skills, you’ll be able to travel more comfortably and confidently. No matter your level, I’ll provide lessons that are tailored to your needs, helping you communicate clearly and enjoy your travels more!

Let’s get you ready for your next adventure!

pro_course_detail.title: English for Interviews: Ace Your Next Job Interview
pro_course_detail.description:
Preparing for a job interview in English can be challenging, but with the right guidance, you can build the confidence and skills needed to succeed. In my English for Interviews lessons, we’ll focus on helping you present yourself effectively, answer common interview questions, and navigate the entire process with ease. As someone who has experience in human resources and recruitment i am confident that i am the right person for you .

What we’ll cover:

Common interview questions and how to answer them confidently
Structuring your responses to highlight your strengths
Cultural differences in interviews and what to expect
Body language and tone for a professional presence
Writing a great CV/Resume in English (if needed)
Job-specific vocabulary
Mock interviews to practice in a real-world setting
These lessons will give you the tools to communicate your qualifications and personality clearly and impressively. Whether it’s a phone interview, video call, or in-person meeting, I’ll help you prepare for every step of the process.

Let’s work together to help you land your dream job!

pro_course_detail.title: "Fun and Engaging English Lessons for Kids!
pro_course_detail.description:
Learning English can be exciting and fun for children, and I’m here to make sure they enjoy every step of the process! In my English for Kids lessons, I use interactive methods to keep young learners engaged while building their language skills.

In our lessons, your child will:

Learn basic vocabulary (colors, animals, food, family, etc.)
Practice simple sentence structures and grammar
Improve speaking and listening skills through songs, games, and stories
Develop confidence in speaking English in everyday situations
Engage in fun activities like role plays and picture-based exercises
Improve reading and writing with beginner-level texts
I adapt my lessons to suit each child’s age, learning style, and interests, ensuring they stay motivated and excited about learning. Whether they’re just starting or have some English knowledge already, I’ll help them progress at their own pace in a fun, relaxed environment.

Let’s give your child the gift of learning English while having a great time!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to my conversation class, designed to help you build confidence and fluency in English through engaging, practical discussions. In each session, we’ll focus on natural, everyday conversation topics, whether it's discussing current events, sharing opinions, or simply talking about hobbies and interests. This class is relaxed and interactive, allowing you to express yourself freely while improving your vocabulary, pronunciation, and overall language structure.

We start each lesson with a warm-up question or a brief chat to help you ease into speaking English. Then, we dive into a topic tailored to your interests and goals. I’ll guide you with questions, prompts, and constructive feedback on how to express ideas more clearly and fluently. Expect lots of encouragement and helpful corrections to ensure you're progressing comfortably.

Additionally, we’ll work on practical conversation skills, such as active listening, responding naturally, and asking follow-up questions to keep conversations flowing. You’ll leave each session with increased confidence and useful expressions that you can immediately apply in real-world situations. This class is suitable for all levels, so whether you're just starting out or looking to polish your English, there’s a place for you here!

Connecting with my students is vital because I plan according to their ability. TPR is the most important teaching style, especially for those who are beginners. I enjoy theme related vocabulary lessons especially work related.

My English teaching journey began in 2008 with Colombian refugees in New Zealand, sparking my passion for languages and education. This led me to help migrants achieve English fluency and confidence.

As an educator, I create a supportive environment where students feel at ease making mistakes, but gently offering corrections when required. My approach emphasizes patience and personalization. I discover each student's interests, encouraging them to express themselves freely on topics they love. I love genuine conversation and connection with my students.

This method develops language skills and self-assurance, empowering learners to communicate effectively and enjoy their progress.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching style is based on a conversational approach. I structure lessons around as much conversation as possible. I encourage students to relax and communicate without fear of mistakes, grammar rules, or accent concerns. 

While I can set homework for reading, listening, and grammar study, our iTalki sessions focus on practicing conversation as much as possible. This method works well, and I'm passionate about sharing it with my students.

As a specialty I also offer help with job interview preparation and practice as well as Resume/CV revision and assistance. I've had great success getting my students into their dream jobs.

pro_course_detail.title: Master English: Learn strategies to improve your english beyond beginner or intermediate level.
pro_course_detail.description:
Language Learning Coaching
In this session, I will be your language learning coach, guiding you with powerful techniques to improve your English, particularly your listening, speaking, reading, and pronunciation skills. I will introduce you to the Input Hypothesis and the concept of comprehensible input, which are proven to be the best methods for acquiring a new language.

I will show you how to use these techniques to learn English naturally and effectively. By engaging with content that is slightly above your current level, you will be constantly challenged and learning. This approach mimics the natural language acquisition process, helping you achieve fluency and confidence in English.

I will also guide you to useful resources and demonstrate the shadowing technique, which involves listening to native speakers and repeating what they say to improve pronunciation and fluency.

Join me to discover these powerful techniques and elevate your English skills to new heights!
